subject: Onsite demo with OmniFin — date options, start time, and NDA

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Riley <eriley@omnifin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite demo: OmniFin HQ — proposed dates & next steps

Ethan — great to reconnect. Thanks for the quick intro call last week. We'd love to host an onsite product demo at our Novato HQ so your data team can see Redwood inference running end-to-end and validate latency/cost targets. Proposed options: 

- Tuesday, Oct 19 — preferred by our infra team
- Wednesday, Oct 20 — available if that works better for your schedule

We typically run a 3-hour session (run-of-show attached) that includes: 1) short exec overview, 2) live demo & performance Q&A, 3) hands-on integration discussion and next steps. Can you confirm:
- preferred date (19 or 20)
- expected headcount and any remote attendees
- any AV or security constraints we should know about

Two operational notes: 
1) We require an NDA on file for visitor labs and system screenshots. I attached our visitor instructions and included a DocuSign link to the NDA for convenience — please return by EOD Wed if possible so facilities can pre-clear badges.
2) If you need hybrid access, we can provide a Zoom bridge and record the session; give us the email addresses for remote participants.

Attachments: Redwood_Visitor_Instructions.pdf (PDF), OmniFin_NDA_DocuSign_Link.txt (link stub)

Thanks —
Kimberly Park

Also: several of our folks will join remotely (security and infra leads). Can you confirm hybrid/Zoom is possible and whether you'll share the recorded session?

On security — I need to route this to our facilities lead for badge pre-clearance. They typically need names and company IDs 72 hours ahead. I copied our onboarding inbox.

If you send the DocuSign NDA I will route it; otherwise happy to sign via our portal.

- Room: Bristol Conf — projector + HDMI, one conference laptop (we'll bring a dongle kit), and spare HDMI cable

- Catering: light breakfast + boxed lunches (confirm headcount by 10/15)
